reasons.claim: Imran b. Husayn is asked passively with no named asker and answers, making him the last link, while al-Tirmidhi's grading remark after the matn is excluded.
reasons.quote: قال سئل عمران بن حصين عن صلاة المسافر، فقال حججت

reasons.claim: Muhammad b. Isa and Musaddad are co-transmitters at the first level, the editorial gloss between dashes is excluded, and both routes share the remaining chain to Abu Musa.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن عيسى، ومسدد، - المعنى - قالا حدثنا هشيم

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni is followed by a back reference with no prior report provided, and the Prophet ends the chain without being a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through the bare relation link and ends at Abu Hurayra, while the phrase describing direct hearing and the Prophet are not links.
reasons.quote: عن يعلى بن عطاء، عن أبيه، عن أبي علقمة، حدثني أبو هريرة، من فيه إلى في

reasons.claim: Three named teachers and an unnamed collective co-transmitter share the remaining chain through Abd al-Razzaq to Umar b. al-Khattab, and al-Tirmidhi's closing remark is not a route.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سلمة بن شبيب، وإسحاق بن منصور، والحسن بن علي الخلال، وغير، واحد، قالوا حدثنا عبد الرزاق

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Ishaq b. Ibrahim al-Hanzali through Hammam b. Munabbih to Abu Hurayra, who relays the Prophet's saying.
reasons.quote: عن همام بن منبه، قال هذا ما حدثنا به أبو هريرة، عن رسول الله

reasons.claim: Al-Hasan b. Muslim b. Yannaq is not merely present; he is the speaker who answers by transmitting from Tawus from Ibn Abbas, so he must be included as a link between Usama b. Zayd and Tawus.
reasons.quote: والحسن بن مسلم بن يناق جالس عنده - فقال حدثني طاوس، أنه سمع ابن عباس

notes: Usama b. Zayd asked Tawus while al-Hasan b. Muslim b. Yannaq was sitting with him, and al-Hasan answered 'Tawus narrated to me that he heard Ibn Abbas', so al-Hasan b. Muslim b. Yannaq is a link before Tawus.

reasons.claim: Ahmad b. Mani' and Ali b. Hujr are co-transmitters sharing the chain to Abu Izza, while the gloss and al-Tirmidhi's closing biographical notes are excluded.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن منيع، وعلي بن حجر، - المعنى واحد قالا حدثنا إسماعيل بن إبراهيم

reasons.claim: The single chain ends at Anas, and the follow-up question to Anas inside the matn adds no new transmitter.
reasons.quote: عن قتادة، عن أنس  رضى الله عنه  قال

reasons.claim: Both readers produce the same route ending at Abu Ja'far, whose words are relayed after Abu Basir's remark.
reasons.quote: عن أبي بصير قال: لا اعلمه ذكره الا عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال:
